state.text: During maintenance, all desks and meeting rooms remain available. Only the printer is unavailable; staff can continue their normal work except for printing.

questions.instruction: Choose the level of disruption explicitly described. Do not infer failures of other services.
levels: 1: one optional service is unavailable, while ordinary work continues
2: several services are unavailable, but ordinary work continues
3: ordinary work must pause for part of the day
4: the whole workplace is closed for the day
